_note: Asset type registry. The scanner tries types IN ORDER, so specific types must come before generic ones ('model' and 'setup' are near-last). Adding a new kind of asset = adding an entry here, not writing code.

ingest_strategies.mesh_plus_textures: One or more mesh files + a set of images. Textures are slot-matched (see texture_slots.json) and recorded in asset.json.
ingest_strategies.texture_set: Images only, sharing a filename stem. UDIM tiles collapse into one entry.
ingest_strategies.single_file: One self-contained file, optionally with a sidecar preview.
ingest_strategies.sequence: Numbered frames (.vdb/.bgeo/.exr/.abc). Stored as one asset with a frame range.
ingest_strategies.folder_blob: Fallback. Keeps the folder exactly as found, wraps it with metadata + thumbnail. Guarantees nothing is un-ingestable.

preview_strategies.render_mesh: Offscreen turntable/still via usdrecord or Storm.
preview_strategies.image_first: Use the highest-priority image found (basecolor > any).
preview_strategies.tonemap: HDR/EXR tonemapped down to a jpg.
preview_strategies.sequence_mid: Render the middle frame of the range.
preview_strategies.passthrough: The asset IS an image; just resize it.
preview_strategies.sidecar: Use a preview file the DCC already wrote next to the asset.
preview_strategies.icon: No preview possible; use the type icon.

_geometry_ext: What ROUTING treats as geometry: any file with one of these extensions lands in geo/, whatever the asset's type. Separate from each type's primary_ext, which answers a DIFFERENT question - what makes this type detectable. Conflating the two is what sent every .fbx in a vegetation asset to extra/: vegetation's primary_ext is .spm/.st/.st9/.srt, the SpeedTree formats, so no mesh file was ever recognised. Also separate from mesh_extensions() in analyse.py, which excludes USD sidecars so a 2.5KB .usdc cannot make a texture set look like a model - that is detection, this is routing, and they must not be merged back together.
_derived_ext: What ROUTING treats as a regenerable bake: any file with one of these extensions lands in derived/, whatever the asset's type. Global for the same reason geometry_ext is - a .rat is a mip-mapped bake of a texture wherever it is found, and whether it sits beside an HDRI, a scan or a texture set says nothing about that. It used to be declared per type and only 'texture' declared it, so a .rat beside an HDRI or a Megascans mesh landed in extra/ - the part of the package that is KEPT and backed up - while derived/ is defined as deletable. One .rat was already in the library that way (tcom_vestrahorn_hdri_sphere_tone.jpg.rat). A type may still add its own in its own derived_ext; the two are unioned, never replaced. .tex is RenderMan's, .b2r is Redshift's.

types.label: Texture set
types.notes: First-class asset, NOT just a dependency of a model. Detected when images share a stem and 2+ distinct slots match.

types.label: HDRI
types.notes: Distinguished from 'texture' by extension + 2:1 aspect ratio + no slot keyword in the name.

types.label: Material
types.notes: Substance Designer/Painter, MaterialX, renderer presets. engine = substance|mtlx|karma|octane|redshift|arnold.

types.label: Houdini asset
types.notes: context = sop|lop|obj|dop|top. Version matters: an H22 HDA will not open in H20.5, so it must be a searchable field.

types.label: Volume / sim cache
types.notes: Embergen exports and Houdini sims. These are HUGE - the UI must show size prominently and migration must never move them without an explicit confirm.

types.label: Geometry cache
types.notes: Animated/deforming geo. Only used when a frame range is detected - a single static .abc is a 'model'.

types.label: Photogrammetry / scan
types.notes: RealityCapture output and 3DGS/Lichtfeld splats (.ply). is_splat separates gaussian splats from meshes. Ties into the existing Point_clean_tool workflow.

types.label: Vegetation / SpeedTree
types.notes: SpeedTree source + its baked exports, kept as one asset. Feeds the existing Speedtree_importer tool.

types.label: Terrain
types.notes: GAEA projects + exported heightfields/masks. VERIFY: .tor = Gaea 2.x, .terrain = Gaea 1.x on your install.

types.label: Garment
types.notes: Marvelous Designer. folder_blob because a .zprj drags along fabrics/avatars/textures we should not try to understand.

types.label: Brush / alpha
types.notes: ZBrush tools/alphas, Photoshop brushes, Mari/Substance alphas. app = zbrush|photoshop|mari|substance. kind = alpha|brush|stencil|tool. VERIFY the ZBrush brush extension on your install.

types.label: LUT / colour
types.notes: DaVinci / Nuke / OCIO. Small and simple - the best first type to test the whole pipeline end to end.

types.label: IES light profile
types.notes: Photometric light profiles. Found as H:/3D/Maya/assets/IES. Preview could later be a rendered light cone, but 'icon' is fine to start.

types.label: Reference
types.notes: Photo refs, PureRef boards, breakdown videos, PDFs. Deliberately loose - the value here is tags + search, not structure.

types.label: Model
types.notes: The generic mesh type. Comes LAST of the mesh types so scan/vegetation get first refusal.

types.label: Scene / setup
types.notes: Not an asset you import - a setup you reopen. Lighting rigs, comp templates, shader tests, lookdev scenes.

types.label: Unsorted
types.notes: Terminal fallback. Nothing is ever rejected by the scanner - it lands here with a name, a thumbnail and tags, and can be retyped later from the UI.
